finding: Blind solver S2 recorded the option about measures adopted deliberately to reduce inequality, although its own working rejected that option (war and inflation are not deliberate) and matched the correct answer; a recording slip, not a key defect. fix: Correct answer reworded to 'having involved more than the shift of workers between sectors, since the fall usually came together with other changes'; deliberate-measures defence and explanation tightened to match 'rarely arrived on its own'.
